question_cn: 象加双兵对单象，进攻方转化优势的关键是：
question_en: Bishop + two pawns vs. lone bishop — the attacker's key to converting the advantage is:

options.text_cn: 用两个兵同时推进，让对方无法兼顾
options.text_en: Advance both pawns simultaneously so the defender can't handle both

options.text_cn: 先换掉一个兵简化局面
options.text_en: Trade one pawn first to simplify
Wait until the bishop is captured before acting

options.text_cn: 两个兵保持在同一排不分开
options.text_en: Keep both pawns on the same rank without separating

explanation_cn: 双兵优势的元思维：分散对方防守力量是胜利的核心。两个兵分开推进 → 对方象顾此失彼 → 至少一个兵升变。这和多子对单子残局的普遍原则一致。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: separate the pawns to overload the defender. Two pawns advancing on different wings → opponent's bishop can't cover both → at least one pawn promotes.
